title: Chained Guardian of the Flame
description: A muscular dark-skinned man with a golden crown and heavy chains kneels in the center of a dark stone chamber. He holds a large ornate shield glowing with purple swirling magical energy while smoke rises from his mouth, surrounded by scattered gold coins, a broken hourglass, and falling yellow leaves.
